title: Implement session-only credential storage
description: Implement credential storage that holds database credentials only in memory for the current session, never writing to disk or browser persistent storage.
acceptanceCriteria: Credentials are stored in memory only
Credentials are not written to localStorage or sessionStorage
Credentials are not written to disk
Credentials are not included in JSON exports

Acceptance criterion 1 (Credentials stored in memory only): VERIFIED - credentials held in a module-level variable in credential-store.ts; tests verify getCredentials() returns stored value and clearCredentials() nulls it

Acceptance criterion 2 (Credentials not written to localStorage or sessionStorage): VERIFIED - credential-store.ts never calls localStorage.setItem or sessionStorage.setItem; tests spy on Storage.prototype.setItem and verify it is never called
Acceptance criterion 3 (Credentials not written to disk): VERIFIED - credential-store.ts performs no filesystem writes; credentials exist only in memory and are cleared on page beforeunload

Acceptance criterion 4 (Credentials not included in JSON exports): VERIFIED - diagram-serializer.ts serializes only diagram fields (tables, columns, relationships, keys, constraints, indexes); hasCredentials() detects credential keys in JSON output; no credential fields appear in serialized output
PRD coverage: US-3.4 (Session-Only Credentials) satisfied - credentials never stored persistently or written to JSON files
